data.name: Shweta
data.gender_notes: Shweta is used as a female name in hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Sanskrit śveta, 'white, pure, bright'. Its root is Sanskrit śveta (श्वेत). A classical Sanskrit term for white. Shweta is a Sanskrit name meaning “White; pure; bright”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Shweta expresses “White; pure; bright”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: From the Sanskrit śveta, 'white, pure, bright'.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Shweta total 22, reducing to 4. Number 4 is associated with discipline, order and steady effort.

data.cultural_impact: Shweta is used in Sanskrit naming tradition with the meaning “White; pure; bright”.
data.spiritual_significance: Any spiritual significance attached to Shweta is interpretive and is labelled as such.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning “White; pure; bright” is the basis of any symbolism attached to Shweta; such symbolism is interpretive.

vedic_reference.note: Name of Saraswati, the goddess of knowledge, music, and learning

historical_references.reference: A classical Sanskrit term for white.
